findings.current: Well, that’s odd. I think this old man just heard a strange voice.
findings.defect: Jeok suspects he is hearing things, not that he heard an unfamiliar voice.
findings.rationale: 환청 means an auditory hallucination; his next question tests whether he really heard the insult.
findings.replacement: Well, that’s odd. I think this old man is hearing things.
findings.source: 지금 노부가 이상한 환청을 들은 것 같은데.

findings.current: The old man who’d been energetically spewing that ridiculous bullshit dropped to the ground with an almost weightless turn.
findings.defect: The draft invents a turn and replaces the old man’s nimble movement with weightlessness.
findings.rationale: 표횰한 움직임 describes agile movement; no turn is specified.
findings.replacement: The old man who’d been energetically spewing that ridiculous bullshit landed nimbly on the ground.
findings.source: 말도 안 되는 개소리를 힘차게 이어 가던 노인이 표횰한 움직임으로 지면에 떨어져 내렸다.

findings.current: I was only curious why they were urging us to surrender after coming all this way with a force powerful enough to smash even Dunhuang.
findings.defect: The draft says the force was capable of smashing Dunhuang, rather than that it had done so.
findings.rationale: 돈황마저 깨부수고 온 states a completed action, not a hypothetical capability.
findings.replacement: I was only curious why they were urging us to surrender when they’d already smashed even Dunhuang with a force this powerful.
findings.source: 다만 이 엄청난 전력을 바탕으로 돈황마저 깨부수고 온 마당에 항복을 권유하는 놈들의 저의가 궁금할 따름이었다.

findings.current: “Bold words from a mere brat. Fine. We’re the Three Elders of Tianshan.”
findings.defect: The elder rebukes Taekyung’s disrespectful manner of address, not his courage.
findings.rationale: 혓바닥이 짧군 targets the younger speaker’s lack of deference.
findings.replacement: “A mere brat speaking to his elders like that? Fine. We’re the Three Elders of Tianshan.”
findings.source: 핏덩이 주제에 혓바닥이 짧군. 좋다, 노부들은 천산삼노(天山三老)라 한다.

findings.current: The third old man—the youngest of them, by the look of it, with a bald head shaped like a heaped bowl of rice—gave a short laugh.
findings.defect: The draft adds baldness and turns the description of the crown of his head into a description of his entire head.
findings.rationale: 고봉밥 정수리 specifies the crown’s shape; it does not say he is bald.
findings.replacement: The third old man—the youngest of them, by the look of it, with a crown like a heaping bowl of rice—gave a short laugh.
findings.source: 서열상 막내임이 분명한 고봉밥 정수리 노인이 피식 웃었다.

findings.current: Hey, have any of you ever heard of the Three Elders of Tianshan?
findings.defect: The draft addresses a group, while Taekyung turns to Jeok Cheongang to ask him.
findings.rationale: The following sentence identifies Jeok as the person Taekyung turns to, and 들어 보셨어요 uses polite singular address in this context.
findings.replacement: Oh, have you ever heard of the Three Elders of Tianshan?

findings.defect: The insult targets their fighting ability, not their fame or identity.
findings.rationale: 좆밥 dismisses them as weak opponents; the ensuing morale boost depends on that assessment.

summary: The draft changes several pragmatic cues and obscures that the enemy had already destroyed Dunhuang.
